Subject: EMEA/APAC forecast ticketing — owner confirmations + lock window

Team —

Quick pulse to lock down owner-level confirmation for the Atlas Health opportunity before finance locks the window on Friday. We need all open forecast tickets to be in the commit tracker (attached) and each owner to confirm one of: Commit / Commit - At-Risk / No Commit. Please do the following by EOD Friday (18 June) 18:00 CET: 

- Update your row in commit-tracker.csv with stage, expected close date, ARR, and a one-line rationale if you mark At-Risk or No Commit.
- If discount asks are outstanding, flag with the reason and link to the PO/negotiation doc.
- If you need a finance pre-approval for any concession, tag Mina directly and include estimated margin impact.

I'll compile a regional rollup Monday and escalate any blockers to CS/Finance.

Attaching: commit-tracker.csv, Q2-forecast-pulse.xlsx (regional rollup template).

Thanks —
Sooj

Thanks Vanessa — good to hear. Two quick asks: 

1) Vanessa, can you confirm if the deal is being offered the standard PLG credit or the enterprise onboarding credit? That affects how we treat revenue recognition and the finance pre-approval threshold.
2) Mina — if Atlas requests a 15% concession on list (they've signalled price sensitivity on user seats), does that require a formal finance approval or can sales approve up to 10%?

I updated the expected close date in the tracker to 2027-06-20 tentatively so the regional rollup doesn't understate Q2.

Thanks —
Karthik
Principal Sales Engineer, EMEA

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: EMEA/APAC forecast ticketing — owner confirmations + lock window

Karthik —

Short answer: Sales can approve up to 10% discount without Finance sign-off for EMEA deals under $250k ARR. Anything >=10% requires finance approval and a simple one-page concession note (reason, expected ARR impact, customer reference). For concessions >=15% we need a two-level signoff: Finance Lead + VP Sales (we'll need a margin impact calc).

Please attach the proposed concession matrix or include the numbers in the commit-tracker discount column. I'll triage approvals same day if the ticket is submitted before 17:00 CET.

Attaching discount-approval-guidelines.pdf for quick reference.

Regards,
Mina Haddad | Director, Revenue Operations & Finance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: discount-approval-guidelines.pdf
